rationale: Round-2 codebase-pin review of 953e9abb (worktree clean, HEAD == reviewed commit). ASSIGNED DUTIES ALL VERIFIED. (1) New pin legs RUN and PASS with real bd+git: TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_EnumerationPin (baseline, 109s — now compares a real claim's porcelain diff against next.ComputeEntangleablePaths(root, root, specID), the dynamic prediction, not a static list), TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_EnumerationPin_RecordingEnabled (105s — recording.enabled + seeded committed manifest in the SPEC WORKTREE, claim run from there; asserts the real diff matches the prediction AND that the prediction names exactly 2 paths, manifest.json + events.ndjson, so the leg can never pass vacuously on an empty prediction), and TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_EnumerationPin_GitignoreEntryAbsent (128s — entry committed absent, prediction computed BEFORE the claim with a fixture-sanity pin that it equals exactly [.gitignore], claim proceeds on the clean tree, post-diff matches, and the claim's own write demonstrably re-added the entry). The config.ResetCache() call in the recording leg correctly handles the in-process config cache the subprocess doesn't share. (2) All four gitignore-refusal variants RUN and PASS (modified 63s / deleted 53s / renamed_away 45s / symlinked 45s): each dirties .gitignore INSIDE the spec worktree (the resolveAnchorRoot-realistic anchor) and claims from there, asserts refusal with the preserved 'cannot claim work' DirtyTreeFailure contract, and proves total no-op — bd status, bead-branch list, worktree list, symlink target, and every checked file's BYTES identical across the refused invocation. The symlink variant legitimately reproduces the git-advisory-on-stderr case that motivated StatusZWithStderr's separate stream capture. (3) next_dirty_test.go's strengthening is exactly the round-1 ask: the stderr assertion now pins the notice's stable identifying prefix ('claiming despite unrelated dirty path(s)') in addition to the path name, so a silent rewording or bare path dump goes red at the real-binary level; the M6 legacy-block pin is retained. Runs green (2s). (4) Both lint-ratchet entries are honest Count-1 registrations, not gate-weakening: the argvAuditTable StatusZWithStderr entry mirrors its StatusWithStderr sibling's Disp/Class and its note is accurate against the implementation (argv is gitArgs(workdir, 'status', '--porcelain', '-z') — workdir operand plus framework-authored flags, no ref/id operand); the compositionCallAllowlist claimAnchorRoot/SpecWorktreePath entry carries the same waist gate as its specWorktreeOrPlaceholder sibling and its degrade-to-repoRoot description matches claimAnchorRoot's code. internal/lint passes uncached, meaning the counts are exact. BEYOND THE DUTIES: verified parsePorcelainZ's rename field order empirically against real git in a scratch repo ('R  new.txt\0old.txt\0' — NEW path first, then original, matching the parser and zRenameRecord); verified HasGitignoreEntry is byte-for-byte the presence check EnsureGitignoreEntry now delegates to (single source of truth, plus the divergence-pinning gitutil test); verified `mindspec repair phase` EXISTS (cmd/mindspec/repair.go) so the new present-but-invalid message steers to a real command; the invalid-phase leg's zero-write assertion uses the specMergeMetadataFn seam correctly. All three round-1 AC-8(i) variants re-run green (397s total), and full uncached unit runs of internal/next (344s), internal/gitutil (140s), internal/approve (385s) pass. My round-1 finding 3 (cmd-level blocking branch e2e-unreachable) is now MOOT — the four refusal variants drive the real binary through that exact branch. My round-1 finding 2 (notice prefix) is addressed in next_dirty_test.go plus the new unit-level TestIgnoredDirtNotice_PinsStableWording. Worktree left byte-identical; scratch fixture cleaned.

findings.title: Round-1 .beads/ pin-sensitivity note remains open (unchanged, still non-blocking)
findings.detail: The sandbox's blanket .beads/ gitignore (internal/harness/sandbox.go) still means all three enumeration-pin legs are blind to a hypothetical future claim write on a tracked .beads path other than issues.jsonl — real installs track .beads/config.yaml etc. while the sandbox ignores the whole directory. No such write exists on the claim path today and the round-2 rework does not change this either way; carrying it forward as a documented sensitivity note only.

findings.title: Recording-leg prediction is post-claim-computed but state-stable, unlike the gitignore leg
findings.detail: TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_EnumerationPin_RecordingEnabled computes want AFTER the claim runs, while the gitignore leg deliberately predicts BEFORE (its own write flips the entry-presence input). This asymmetry is correct as written — the recording class's inputs (recording.enabled, spec worktree existence, path resolution) are not changed by the claim itself, so pre/post computation is equivalent there — but a future edit that makes the recording class state-flipping too would silently inherit the post-computation. A one-line comment noting why post-computation is safe for THIS leg would keep the asymmetry from being copied blindly. Cosmetic; no change required.
